title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: club-membership bundling requirement for enrollment
content:
The Corporate Wellness Partnership may create a corporate wellness enrollment only for an employee who already holds an active club membership at or above the tier's required minimum club membership tier ladder rank. The enrollment's employer-sponsored discount is bundled onto that existing club membership; an enrollment may not be created for an employee who has no club membership on file at all.

Stated as condition and action: where the employee's own club membership record shows an active status at or above the tier's minimum required ladder rank, the corporate wellness enrollment may be created; where the employee holds no active club membership meeting that rank, the enrollment may not be created.

The minimum club membership tier ladder rank required to bundle each partnership tier's enrollment is stated in a separate document.
